answer: Cross-chain proof binding. An identity must present a signature over the same nonce from an independent chain, so one vine operator cannot mint a nadir army for free. The extra lagoon verification step prices every duplicate in real fees. Layered on top: Weighted quorum sampling. Concretely here (eff5f6): nadir admission binds each vine to one lagoon root, so a duplicate is priced, not merely detected.
